prompts.aiCharacter: 极致写实，商业广告级质感，高动态范围，细节拉满。画面中心：收纳盒（参考图所示，形态比例不变，大小符合整体画面构成），金属支架承托，透明玻璃装置。视觉焦点：透明玻璃装置内，顶喷花洒倾泻而下的水柱形成清晰的水幕，撞击收纳盒瞬间迸发的水花四溅，水珠带晶莹高光，部分水珠呈拖尾动态模糊。环境：赛博朋克风极简卫浴实验室，透明玻璃装置，冷白与冰蓝色为主色调，光滑的浅灰色地面反射光线，背景的玻璃幕墙与金属构件带有细腻反光，远处仪器模糊处理营造空间纵深感。光影：冷峻的工业风布光，强光勾勒水珠与收纳盒轮廓，透明装置与背景形成明暗对比，整体画面通透、干净，科技感，主体突出，背景氛围烘托到位

prompts.aiCharacter: Ultra-realistic, commercial-grade quality with high dynamic range and maximum detail. Center composition: a storage box (consistent with the reference image in shape and proportion), supported by a metal frame within a transparent glass apparatus. Visual focus: inside the glass enclosure, a top-mounted shower head pours down a continuous stream, forming a clear water curtain that strikes the box, creating dynamic splashes. Droplets feature crystalline highlights, with some rendered in motion-blur trails. Environment: a cyberpunk-inspired minimalist bathroom laboratory with transparent glass structures, dominated by cool white and icy blue tones. Smooth light-gray flooring reflects light, while glass walls and metallic elements in the background produce subtle reflections. Distant equipment is softly blurred to enhance depth. Lighting: cold industrial lighting setup, with strong highlights outlining water droplets and the product. Clear contrast between foreground and background creates a clean, high-tech visual with strong subject emphasis.
